messages:
sam: quick heads-up — noticed a bunch of ambiguous nouns in microcopy/examples: some pages say 'model version', others say 'variant' or just 'model'. thinking we should pick one for prose. propose 'model variant' for docs. thoughts? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/879
elaine: +1 to 'model variant' — clearer for runtime vs. code versions. keep it in prose, not SDK param names.
raj: fyi infra/APIs currently use model_version in payloads. if we change docs, add a note to avoid confusion (and don't break API). :thinking:
sam: agreed — not renaming API fields. this is purely docs wording + examples. we'll add a parenthetical: "model variant (API: model_version)" where needed.
leo: small example suggestion for SDK snippets:

```
# current
client.generate(model="redwood-7b-v1")
# docs-friendly prose
client.generate(model="redwood-7b-v1")  # where 'model' refers to the model variant in use
```

elaine: i'd avoid changing the ergonomic SDK param from 'model' to 'model_variant' — that causes churn. prose should consistently use 'model variant' though.
sam: ok compromise: keep SDK 'model' param, call it out in snippet comments, and use 'model variant' in headings and paragraphs. i'll add a glossary entry that ties the terms together.
raj: can you also add a short note in the API reference that 'model_version' is an accepted field and maps to the same concept? i'll coordinate with API folks to keep aliases documented.
sam: yep — i'll open a small PR for glossary + example updates: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/879
sam: TODOs: sam -> create PR + update examples; elaine -> review phrasing & tone; raj -> confirm API alias + CHANGES note; leo -> run repo search for 'model version' occurrences and list pages.
elaine: timeline?
sam: aiming EOD tomorrow to get the PR up. if delayed, slide to start of next sprint.
ops-bot: Deploy bot: new PR opened by sam — #879 (status: draft)
sam: assigning reviewers @elaine @raj @leo :+1:
leo: quick scan found ~12 hits across docs (examples, SDK snippets, glossary draft). i'll paste list into PR comment.
raj: API team confirmed alias acceptance (model_version still supported). we'll add a changelog line and a brief backward-compatibility note.
sam: thanks. i'll add a migration note in SDK snippets section showing both forms and a short explanation.
elaine: tiny voice/tone note — avoid 'just' and 'simply' in examples; sounds dismissive. also prefer active voice.
sam: good call. i'll remove 'just' from examples during sweep.
leo: leaving a quick checklist in the PR for reviewers: 1) glossary entry, 2) examples updated, 3) API note, 4) tone pass.
sam: will ping here when PR is ready for review. thanks all :rocket:
